chapters.title: CAB: cash at bank, week by week
chapters.text: This is C A B, cash at bank. It checks, week by week, that the money we should have matches the money we really have.

chapters.title: Each day: cash in, bills, expenses, running balance
chapters.text: Each day shows the cash counted, the bills and expenses paid, and the running balance, which is the money we should have.

chapters.title: End of the week: tap + New CAB Confirm
chapters.text: At the end of the week, tap plus New C A B Confirm.

chapters.title: Type the real bank, MoMo and cash amounts
chapters.text: Check the bank balance and the MoMo balance, count the physical cash, and type the real amounts.

chapters.title: Tap Verify: the difference shows
chapters.text: Then confirm it. The difference shows anything that does not match, and weeks not yet confirmed still need checking.

chapters.title: The laws and this video: 📜 Laws
chapters.text: The laws of this page, and this video, are on the Laws button.
